The why is written into the roadmap, so §6's completion review will read O2–O4 as dropped on purpose, not as missing. I haven't added them to `specs/deferred_items.md`, because that would keep them aging as live backlog. If you'd rather park them there, say so.

**Commit on `main`**, so the fresh session reads it:

```
git add specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md
git commit -m "Roadmap resume 2026-11-06: stop Track A after Stage 1; O2–O4 dropped"
```
